nodes.name: Get MIDI File
nodes.description: Gets a MIDI provided a path to the file with the file picker.

inputs.name: File Path
inputs.description: Absolute path to a .mid file on disk.

outputs.name: Tracks
outputs.description: All tracks in the MIDI file with their notes and controller events.

outputs.name: Tempo
outputs.description: The file's tempo changes as [BPM, seconds] pairs, in order. The first is at 0 seconds (120 BPM if the file doesn't set one).

outputs.name: MIDI Stats
outputs.description: Human-readable track count and duration.

nodes.name: Get MIDI Track Data
nodes.description: Gets a MIDI track's data from an array of MIDI Tracks.

inputs.name: Tracks
inputs.description: Tracks to pick from, usually from Get MIDI File.

inputs.name: Track Name
inputs.description: Name of the track to extract; must exactly match a track name.

outputs.name: Notes
outputs.description: Notes of the selected track, times in seconds.

outputs.name: Control Change
outputs.description: Control change events of the selected track, keyed by CC number.

outputs.name: Pitchwheel
outputs.description: Pitch wheel events of the selected track.

outputs.name: Aftertouch
outputs.description: Aftertouch events of the selected track.

outputs.name: Unique Note Numbers
outputs.description: Every note number used in the selected track, sorted low to high with no repeats.

nodes.name: Keyframes from Object
nodes.description: Get keyframes from an object in the scene.

inputs.name: ObjectGroups
inputs.description: Object groups from the scene, usually from Scene Link.

inputs.name: Object Group Name
inputs.description: Name of the object group that contains the source object.

inputs.name: Object Name
inputs.description: The id of the object whose animation curves are read (a name is matched too). Blender's object ids are their names.

inputs.name: Channels
inputs.description: The channels to output, by the bridge's channel ids. Blender's are data paths, with the index for one component of an array: location[2], pose.bones["Arm"].rotation_euler[0], key_blocks["Smile"].value or ["prop"].

outputs.name: Dynamic Output
outputs.description: One output per picked channel, its id is the channel, e.g. location[2].

outputs.name: Available Channels
outputs.description: Every channel of the object that has keyframes, { id, group, name, label }: name is the channel's name in its group with its axis, label the output's name. These are the values channels can hold.

nodes.name: Animation Generator
nodes.description: Create animation generators based on keyframed data

inputs.name: Name
inputs.description: Name of the generator; objects reference their animation by this name.

inputs.name: Note On Keyframes
inputs.description: Animation curves played at each note-on, timed relative to the note start. Each curve plays on its own channel (its Blender path and index), at most one curve per channel.

inputs.name: Note On Anchor Point
inputs.description: Frames added to every note-on keyframe's time.

inputs.name: Note Off Keyframes
inputs.description: Animation curves played at each note-off, timed relative to the note end. Each curve plays on its own channel, a note-on curve on the same channel plays on the same Blender curve.

inputs.name: Note Off Anchor Point
inputs.description: Frames added to every note-off keyframe's time.

inputs.name: Time Mapper
inputs.description: Gives each key's new time in frames, relative to the curve, before the note's offset and velocity intensity, e.g. x * 2 or x + 5 if note == 38 else x. Connect a Note Table, or type one in. Expressions are Python expression syntax (arithmetic, comparisons, and/or/not, a if c else b, lists, in, range, abs/min/max/round/int/float/bool/sum/len, math functions bare or as math.name, plus clamp(v, lo, hi) and lerp(a, b, t)). Empty changes nothing. Variables: x (the key's time in frames, relative to the curve; frames is the same), sec (that time in seconds), y (the key's value), note, vel (0-127), dur and dur_sec (note length in frames and seconds), t and t_sec (the note's start in the song), octave (note // 12 - 1, middle C 60 is 4), pc (note % 12), index (the note's position in its track, from 0), gap and gap_sec (time since the previous note started, inf for the first), prev and next (the previous and next note numbers, -1 when there isn't one), held (notes sounding at the note's start, itself included), fps (the scene's frame rate, 24 with no scene).

inputs.name: Amplitude Mapper
inputs.description: Gives each key's new value before velocity intensity, e.g. y if note == 46 else 0 (a cymbal choke with overlap next) or y * vel / 127. Connect a Note Table, or type one in. Expressions are Python expression syntax (arithmetic, comparisons, and/or/not, a if c else b, lists, in, range, abs/min/max/round/int/float/bool/sum/len, math functions bare or as math.name, plus clamp(v, lo, hi) and lerp(a, b, t)). Empty changes nothing. Variables: x (the key's time in frames, relative to the curve; frames is the same), sec (that time in seconds), y (the key's value), note, vel (0-127), dur and dur_sec (note length in frames and seconds), t and t_sec (the note's start in the song), octave (note // 12 - 1, middle C 60 is 4), pc (note % 12), index (the note's position in its track, from 0), gap and gap_sec (time since the previous note started, inf for the first), prev and next (the previous and next note numbers, -1 when there isn't one), held (notes sounding at the note's start, itself included), fps (the scene's frame rate, 24 with no scene).

inputs.name: Velocity Intensity
inputs.description: Scales keyframe values by note velocity; 0 ignores velocity.

inputs.name: Animation Overlap
inputs.description: How a note combines with an animation still playing on the same curve: add, min, max, prev (previous), next, rvc (rest value crossing), prune (keyframe pruning), crossfade or momentum (keys keep their keyed timing, crowded notes are trimmed and joined so nothing moves faster than it was keyed). Empty = add.

inputs.name: Overlap Blend
inputs.description: Crossfade only: seconds to ease from the animation still playing into the note. Unset = 0.1.

inputs.name: Dampen
inputs.description: Momentum only: how much crowded notes shrink, from 0 (not at all) to 1 (as much as they're crowded). Unset = 0.

inputs.name: Use Anchor Point Value
inputs.description: Momentum only: dampening shrinks toward the hit's value so every hit still lands. Off shrinks toward rest. Unset = on.

inputs.name: Windup
inputs.description: Momentum only: frames from the hit back to the windup's peak on the note on curve, negative. A crowded note keeps its windup longest: the old rest is cut, then the old recoil, then the windup shrinks. Unset finds it on the curve (the flat point before the hit furthest from the hit's value).

inputs.name: Recoil
inputs.description: Momentum only: frames from the hit to where the note on curve is back from it (at rest, or the top of a bounce), positive. Unset finds it on the curve (the first flat point after the hit that has moved away from it).

outputs.name: Animation Generator
outputs.description: The generator settings, consumed by Assign Notes to Objects.

nodes.name: Note Table
nodes.description: A value per note, from a curve over the notes of a note map (spaced evenly) or a range, with values typed in over it. Gives the expression for Animation Generator's Time Mapper or Amplitude Mapper.

inputs.name: Note Map
inputs.description: Each object's notes, from Assign Notes to Objects' Note Map: { "Cube.001": [58] }. The table has a row per note, with the objects it plays. Unconnected, the table is a range whatever its source is.

inputs.name: Table
inputs.description: The table's settings, every field optional: { "target": "amplitude" | "time" (the key's value y, or its time x in frames), "operation": "multiply" | "add" | "set", "source": "map" | "range" (the connected note map, or every note from "from" to "to"), "from": 36, "to": 47, "shape": "linear" ("constant" gives every note min), "curve": "t ** 2" (an expression in t, 0 at the first note and 1 at the last, and note), "min": 0, "max": 1 (the curve goes from min to max), "overrides": [{ "note": 49, "value": 0.7 }], "fallback": "keep" | "zero" | "value" (notes not in the table), "fallback_value": 0 }.

outputs.name: Expression
outputs.description: The expression the table gives, connect it to a mapper.

outputs.name: Preview
outputs.description: The rows and curve the node shows.

nodes.name: Set Channel
nodes.description: Move a curve's keys to another channel, e.g. play keys made on Location Z on Rotation Y.

inputs.name: Keyframes
inputs.description: The curve to move, usually from Keyframes from Object.

inputs.name: Channel
inputs.description: Blender path with its index, e.g. location[2], rotation_euler[1], pose.bones["Arm"].location[0] or key_blocks["Smile"].value[0]. Empty leaves the curve on its own channel.

outputs.name: Keyframes
outputs.description: The same keys on the new channel.

nodes.name: Assign Notes to Objects
nodes.description: Assign notes to objects in the scene

inputs.name: ObjectGroups
inputs.description: Object groups from the scene, usually from Scene Link.

inputs.name: Object Group Name
inputs.description: Name of the object group whose objects receive notes.

inputs.name: Mode
inputs.description: "rules" works out each object's notes from Notes or Note Numbers (methods 1-4), "map" takes them from Note Map.

inputs.name: Notes
inputs.description: Notes to distribute; objects named with a note (Cube_60, Cube_C3) take that note, the others get the remaining unique pitches in name order.

inputs.name: Note Numbers
inputs.description: One note number per object, in object name order; overrides Notes for the assignment. A connected list, or text typed in like "60, 61, 62" (commas or spaces). Must match the object count. Empty uses Notes.

inputs.name: Animation Generator
inputs.description: Animation generators, any number of them, each with its own name. In rules mode every object plays all of them on its notes. In map mode each object plays the ones wired to it in the note map.

inputs.name: Note Map
inputs.description: Each object's notes and animations in map mode, drawn by pressing Tab on the node: { "objects": { "Cube": [60, 62] }, "animations": { "Hit": ["Cube"] }, "notes": [65] }. "animations" are the objects each animation (a generator's name) plays on, for every note the object has. A map without "animations" plays every animation on every object. "notes" are added notes nothing is connected to yet.

inputs.name: Map Layout
inputs.description: Where notes, animations and objects were moved to in the note map, by id ("n:60", "a:Hit", "o:Cube"): [x, y]. Only the app reads it.

outputs.name: Object Map
outputs.description: Mapping of object names to note numbers and animation generators.

outputs.name: Note Map
outputs.description: Each object's notes, without the animation: { "Cube.001": [58], "Cube.002": [59] }. It doesn't use the Animation Generator, so it can feed a Note Table that feeds that same generator.

nodes.name: Viewer
nodes.description: Display node results

inputs.name: Input
inputs.description: Any value to display in the node.

inputs.name: Depth
inputs.description: How many levels deep to show before collapsing to [Object] or [Array(n)].

inputs.name: Keys Per Object
inputs.description: How many keys of each object to show.

inputs.name: Items Per Array
inputs.description: How many items of each array to show.

inputs.name: String Length
inputs.description: How many characters of each string to show.

inputs.name: Compact Width
inputs.description: Values shorter than this many characters stay on one line.

nodes.name: Scene Link
nodes.description: Provide access to the scene

outputs.name: Name
outputs.description: Name of the linked Blender scene.

outputs.name: Object Groups
outputs.description: Object groups (collections) in the linked scene with their objects.

nodes.name: Merge Object Maps
nodes.description: Merge object maps so objects can have several animations

inputs.name: Object Map
inputs.description: Object maps to merge, a new input appears for each one connected. Objects in several maps get the animations of all of them, each keeping its own notes; two different generators with the same name are an error.

outputs.name: Object Map
outputs.description: The merged object map, connect to Evaluate Instrument.

nodes.name: Scene Writer
nodes.description: Write keyframes to the Blender scene

inputs.name: Keyframes
inputs.description: Keyframes per object from Evaluate Instrument.

inputs.name: Clean Keyframes
inputs.description: Clear each object's existing animation before writing. Off adds the keys to the curves already there.

nodes.name: Frame
nodes.description: A labeled box around nodes, only for organizing them. It never runs.

nodes.name: Group
nodes.description: Runs a node group. Its sockets come from the group's Group Input and Group Output. Press Tab to open it.

nodes.name: Group Input
nodes.description: Inside a node group: the values given to the group node's inputs.

nodes.name: Group Output
nodes.description: Inside a node group: the values the group node outputs.

nodes.name: For Each
nodes.description: Start of a for each zone. The nodes between it and its For Each Output run once per item.

inputs.name: Items
inputs.description: The list to loop over.

outputs.name: Element
outputs.description: The current item.

outputs.name: Index
outputs.description: Position of the current item, starting at 0.

outputs.name: Count
outputs.description: Number of items.

outputs.name: Previous
outputs.description: The item before the current one, nothing for the first.

outputs.name: Next
outputs.description: The item after the current one, nothing for the last.

nodes.name: For Each Output
nodes.description: End of a for each zone. Collects what reaches Result on each item into a list.

inputs.name: Result
inputs.description: Value to collect for the current item.

outputs.name: Results
outputs.description: The collected values, one per item in order.

nodes.name: Note Targets
nodes.description: Lists which objects, with which animation, each note number triggers.

inputs.name: Object Map
inputs.description: Object-to-note mapping from Assign Notes to Objects.

outputs.name: Targets
outputs.description: Objects and animations per note number.

nodes.name: Targets for Note
nodes.description: The objects and animations one note triggers.

inputs.name: Targets
inputs.description: Targets per note number from Note Targets.

inputs.name: Note
inputs.description: The note to look up.

outputs.name: Targets
outputs.description: What this note triggers, empty if nothing.

nodes.name: Note Keyframes
nodes.description: The keyframes one note plays on one target: the generator's keys through its mappers, moved to the note's time and scaled by velocity.

inputs.name: Object Map
inputs.description: Where the target's animation is looked up.

inputs.name: Target
inputs.description: Object and the name of the animation to play.

inputs.name: Note
inputs.description: The note that plays it.

inputs.name: Notes
inputs.description: The track the note is in, for the mappers' index, gap, prev, next and held. Unconnected, the note is on its own.

inputs.name: Index
inputs.description: Where the note is in Notes, from a For Each's Index. Unconnected, it's looked up.

outputs.name: Keys
outputs.description: Keyframes on the target's curve, nothing if the generator has no keys.

nodes.name: Combine Keyframes
nodes.description: Combines every note's keys per object and curve in note order, using each generator's animation overlap mode.

inputs.name: Object Map
inputs.description: Every object in the map gets keyframes, objects with no notes are cleared.

inputs.name: Keys
inputs.description: CurveKeys from Note Keyframes in note order, lists inside lists are flattened.

outputs.name: Keyframes
outputs.description: Keyframes per object. Connect to Scene Writer to write them to Blender.
